name: Globe Life
description: Globe Life sells low-face-amount life insurance and supplemental health insurance to lower-middle and middle-income families, mostly through exclusive agent forces and direct-to-consumer marketing. Life premium was $3.4 billion and health premium $1.5 billion in 2025; the American Income Life agency alone produces 53 percent of life premium. The company says it runs lower policy-acquisition and administrative expense than peers, which is how it holds high underwriting margins (life 45 cents per premium dollar). Investment income of $1.1 billion is a further 19 percent of revenue.

sub.name: Life, retirement and supplemental health insurers

gics.note: Conventional label per Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-10-01), which gives only the sector and the sub-industry; GICS industry group and industry are not shown there so are left null. Mowgli classification is not set here.

employees.note: Full-time, part-time and temporary employees (FY2025 10-K); agents at the exclusive agencies are separate

businessLines.name: Life insurance
businessLines.how: Policyholders pay level premiums monthly or annually for years; earnings are premiums less claims and acquisition cost (underwriting margin), plus investment income. Premium is predictable; sales growth requires adding agents.
businessLines.description: Term and whole life insurance sold through American Income Life, Liberty National and Direct to Consumer (plus independent-agent and other channels).

revenue.note: Life premium; FY2024 $3,261.3M (+3%); investment income is not allocated to the line here. Net sales $948M total across life and health in 2025 (+13%)
